limitations: Method wrappers add timing overhead; diagnostic outcome cannot substitute for production qualification.
CID cached-layout recognition is not live registry fast-branch profiling.
Worker-entry remaining timeout includes child admission; further subprocess-time allocation is not directly observed.
Host file download is bounded by producer file limits and post-download regular-file size checks, not a separate streaming byte cap.
reviewed_contracts: Launcher verifies unchanged archive bytes and eight frozen/archive/live producer pins; requires fresh output and explicit rootGO diagnostic marker.

Instrumentation installs only in-memory class/method wrappers after existing production _pins call; source-unit module wrappers install via sys.modules only after production imports it inside native timer.
Native manifest producer guard remains recognized and unchanged before/after class and module wrappers.
Snapshots read CID memo/layout cache_info without initializing lazy native layout; cold control proves counters unchanged by diagnostic snapshots.
Post-context inspection of already populated layout is narrowly labeled cached-layout recognition, not proof of active fast branch.
Actual CID encode/validate memo hits/misses/current size and manifest hit/miss/bypass/retention counters are emitted.
Worker timeout field is labeled entry budget before child admission and subprocess allocation; exact subprocess allocation is not claimed.
Arguments, staticmethod descriptor and exception identity are preserved by bounded controls; only finite timeout/memory scalars and error class name enter events.
Event stream is bounded4096 events/1MiB with dropped-event count; summary is bounded32768 bytes; no paths, state, source text, formulas or payload contents are recorded in timing events.
Diagnostic finish restores wrappers even if stream close fails; host fetches bounded event/summary files before original container cleanup, each download under30 seconds.
Outer result always labels diagnostic_only and production_qualification_claimed false; raw production wrapper output is retained as diagnostic evidence even if instrumented native path passes.
verdict: no blocker; suitable for root-authorized diagnostic-only run
